First-time funding transfer s that are canceled for one of the above reasons is retried at a later date. This retry logic is different depending

on the cancelation reason: If the can celation is because of NSF at the counterparty, try it Oct 14, [value] with a balance check then as well.

Analysis: Each page in `confluence_policies.txt` is HTML on a single long line! Let's write a python script to strip HTML tags / unescape HTML entities and format each page nicely into readable lines so we can read every policy page.
Plan: Parse and format `confluence_policies.txt` into plain text and print out the pages.
bash_command

cat << 'EOF' > parse_pages.py
import re, html

with open("confluence_policies.txt") as f:
    text = f.read()

text = re.sub(r'</(p|h1|h2|h3|h4|li|tr|div)>', '\n', text)
text = re.sub(r'<br\s*/?>', '\n', text)
text = re.sub(r'<(td|th)[^>]*>', ' | ', text)
text = re.sub(r'<[^>]+>', '', text)
text = html.unescape(text)
text = re.sub(r'\n{3,}', '\n\n', text)

with open("policies_clean.txt", "w") as f:
    f.write(text)

for i, line in enumerate(text.splitlines(), 1):
    if line.startswith("PAGE "):
        print(f"Line {i}: {line}")
print(f"Total lines: {len(text.splitlines())}")
EOF
